title: Steel Sander
body:
"All you need in life is water, which is why this is better than the rusty sander!"


Description

The Steel Sander can be purchased at Oak Depot for $8,500. It turns normal wood into sanded wood by removing its bark. It is the second best sander in the game.

Appearance

The Steel sander looks similar to the Industrial Sander except it is blue in color, and also has rims compared to a more futuristic look to the Industrial Sander.
